name: MSCI ACWI (All World)
description: MSCI World plus ~24 emerging markets (~2,500 stocks). Comparable to FTSE All-World.
source: MSCI index 892400, USD. From 2001-01: net total return, daily levels (msci.com), month = last level of the month. 1988-01 – 2000-12: MSCI gross total return (monthly, via github.com/NandayDev/MSCI-Historical-Data) minus the gross–net gap of later years (0.51 % p.a.); variance and SMA signal from daily developed-market returns (Kenneth French, scaled to the month's return) from 1990-07, estimated before.
